The primary subject is a rectangular white sign with black, nonsensical text mounted on two dark vertical posts. Above it are other signs: a partial white sign with black text on the left, and a circular sign with an orange/brown abstract symbol on the right. The background includes a red brick building facade, a window, and a large clock face near the top. The lighting suggests daytime or early evening.
